Title: SQL Server Analysis Services Virtual Machine images now available
Services: SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines

Body.Content:
Now in general availability, you have the option to migrate SQL Server Analysis Services workloads into Azure using pre-configured virtual machine images. This feature enables you to easily see your different virtual machine workloads and manage them. It can also help make your workloads more efficient and enables an easier onboarding experience to the cloud. With this feature, you can leverage additional benefits from moving to the cloud since you can select these preconfigured images on Azure marketplace.

Learn More.
